name: Jeff Brown
reason: Conspiracy / political-commentary rule: his own YouTube channel (Enrealment Media, linked from jeffbrown.co) is dominated in the past year by videos about his book 'In Trudeau's Kitchen', including claims of manipulation by Justin Trudeau's protection team and police obstruction, a 'Ruse Noose (Mildec)' military-deception story, an 'intimidating wiretap experience', and 'Freeing Iran and Freeing Canada' from Washington DC. Under the brief, a channel carrying conspiracy or partisan political commentary means the teacher is skipped even though his site's courses (Soulshaping sessions $150 USD, sliding-scale audio courses on sacred purpose and writing) and email (jeff [at] jeffbrown [dot] co, contact page) would otherwise qualify. A human may want to look; no base is published (his story 'began in Toronto').
